Class RMIClientView

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Network.Connection.RMI.RMIClientView
All Implemented Interfaces:
RemoteView, Serializable, Remote
public class RMIClientView extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RemoteView
Client-side implementation of RemoteView. Receives NetworkMessage instances from the server (via RMI callback) and enqueues them in a BlockingQueue; the client pump drains them through RMIServerConnection.receive().
